observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: Indoor stage with dark backdrop and red curtains, theatrical lighting.
observation.dancers: A large group of dancers including children/teens, mixed gender, plus one solo dancer.
observation.formation_and_space: Group starts lying on the floor, transitions into circles, lines, and pyramid formations across the stage.
observation.posture: Upright torso during upbeat dance segments; bending knees in sync, occasional low crouches.
observation.footwork: Bouncy stepping, running steps, fast footwork on the beat, squats and jumps; precise details obscured by wide stage framing.
observation.arms_and_hands: Arms swing, reach up, wave, or hold skirts; solo dancer carries a white guitar.
observation.hips_and_torso: Energetic torso bounces, hip sways, and drops matching the tempo.
observation.partnering: Group choreography with occasional lifts and human pyramid formations.
observation.levels_jumps_turns: Jumps, floor drops, handstands, splits, and spins.
observation.costume_and_props: Dancers wear colorful flared skirts, black tops with skeleton-like white accents, face paint resembling skulls, and white sneakers. Solo dancer wears a red hoodie, black pants, face paint, and holds a white guitar.
observation.cannot_infer: Exact foot placement and intricate weight transfers cannot be verified due to wide stage camera angles.

signature_moments.what: Dancers form a circle holding hands while stepping sideways in unison.
Dancers build a tiered group pose/pyramid on stage.
Solo dancer performs a handstand on stage while group poses around them.
Group drops low and performs synchronized knee bounces and arm movements.
Dancers drop to floor levels while solo dancer executes a dynamic jump.
